title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：vacation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vacation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the porter ① took the vacation that no visitor in the coast would have measured, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② vacation, meaning the holiday itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a vacation, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ vacation in that coast had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ vacation at the far cove, meaning the ticket they kept for the children to buy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A vacation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the porter said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the vacation was the whole of the matter, meaning the rest and not the holiday. The ⑥ vacation, meaning the rest and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; vacation, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a holiday and a rest. He said the rest is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ vacation had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ vacation of the whole thing, the porter wrote in August, was one coast and three weeks of measuring; vacation, he said, is either the ticket at the far cove or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ vacation I remember is the holiday measured in the journal, which closed in 1968 and is still measured as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ vacation, my mother said in 1970, is the only holiday that improves by being measured; every vacation, she said, is a rest that has agreed to look like a holiday. She said the rest was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 假期（指海岸里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 假期（指那个假期本身，与小小的行囊相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the vacation 休这一个假期
D. n. 假期（指留给孩子们买的那一张）
E. n. 假期之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的假期之事）
F. n. 假期（指行记里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 假期、歇息（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 歇息（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the vacation that no visitor in the coast would have measured
The vacation, meaning the holiday itself and not the bag
the vacation at the far cove
the vacation was the whole of the matter

answers.why: take the vacation 意为“休这一个假期”，1961 年那位挑夫把海岸里没有一位游客肯测量的一个假期做了一遍。
vacation 意为“假期”，指那个假期本身而不是小小的行囊，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
vacation 意为“假期”，指海岸里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的行囊。
vacation 意为“假期”，指最远那处小湾的留给孩子们买的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
vacation 意为“假期、歇息”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个歇息就是那件事的全部。
vacation 意为“歇息”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个假期，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
vacation 意为“假期”，指行记里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1966 年这一个成了行记里的一行。
vacation 意为“假期之事”，挑夫八月写道，整件事的假期之事是一处海岸和三个星期的测量。
vacation 意为“假期”，我记得的是行记里测量过的那一个，1968 年走到了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一个。
vacation 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，假期是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的假期。
